exposure: peripartum maternal admission to the intensive care unit
cohort: Women with peripartum admission to the intensive care unit at a tertiary care center
finding: While patient characteristics and admission diagnoses for peripartum maternal intensive care unit admissions remained consistent over 15 years, there was a significant increase in postpartum hemorrhage and cesarean hysterectomy, and a decrease in preterm births and peripartum neonatal intensive care unit admissions.
mod_finding: There was a significant increase in postpartum hemorrhage and cesarean hysterectomy over time among women transferred to the intensive care unit.
